recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surrealist composition featuring a central female figure in avant-garde white attire standing on the edge of a futuristic, open-air pink train car. The scene is set high above a cloud-filled cityscape bathed in a blindingly bright, ethereal sunburst, utilizing a dominant pink and white color palette with metallic textures.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure acts as a vertical bridge between the metallic pink train structure and the soft white clouds.
The harsh geometric lines of the train frame contrast with the organic, flowing hair and soft clouds.
The central sunburst creates a halo effect that silhouettes the left side of the subject while illuminating the right.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic pink lighting across all metallic surfaces
High-altitude perspective with a visible horizon line of clouds
Futuristic transportation elements (train interior, grab poles) rendered in glossy pink

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body figure, slightly off-center to the right, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical pink grab pole on the left third line, providing structural stability to the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright sunburst on the left, moves across the subject's face and crown, follows the pink train roof to the right, and descends through the seating area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and cloud area on the left side, balanced by the dense interior detail of the train on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta-pink (used for lighting, structures, and atmospheric haze)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (used for clothing, clouds, and the central light source)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver (used for jewelry, headpiece, and floor reflections)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks with extremely high value (brightness) in the whites, creating a glowing, overexposed effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit dark shadows to deep magenta rather than black

composition.position: Top right, inside a digital display panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for environmental realism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, and authoritative look of the display text.
Provides a clean, modern, and industrial feel suitable for transportation signage.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a futuristic open-air train car interior in glossy pink metal, floating above a sea of pink-tinted clouds with a distant skyscraper skyline. A blinding white sunburst should be on the left. The right side features pink benches and a window showing a city view. Include a black rectangular display panel on the upper right ceiling frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add condensed white sans-serif text inside the black display panel, skewed to match the perspective of the train's roofline. Apply a slight outer glow to simulate an LED screen.

verificationChecks: Is the text perspective-aligned to the train's architecture?
Does the text appear to be emitting light?
Is the font a clean, condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink color grade
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Branded logos or specific trademarked jewelry designs
Exact wording of the display text

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of 3D environment and subject
avoid: Low-resolution textures on the train interior

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sunburst does not wash out the subject's face entirely.
Check that the pink lighting is reflected on the white clothing.
Verify the perspective of the train floor tiles matches the horizon.
Confirm the text is legible but integrated into the environment.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Futuristic Transportation] + [Monochromatic Pink Lighting] + [High-Altitude Cloudscape] + [Avant-Garde Fashion Subject] to create a surreal, ethereal portrait.
